novel_facts: Three candidates: John Dial, Sarah Heard, John Kaz Kazanjian
August 18 Primary Election for Martin County
decision.reason: The incoming article covers a Martin County Commission District 4 race with three candidates (Dial, Heard, Kazanjian), while the candidate covers an Indian River County Commission District 2 race with four candidates. These are completely different county commission races in different counties (Martin vs. Indian River) for different districts (4 vs. 2) with different candidates. The high headline similarity is due to generic election coverage vocabulary and the same source format, but there are no concrete shared anchors. The same August 18 election date is a regional primary date, not a unique identifier.
